verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI ships 'clai', a built-in CLI assistant users can chat with and delegate tasks to, plus a documented 'complete coding agent' with file access, shell, and planning capabilities (docs-3, docs-15/16/17, docs-32/33). However, this is a framework/dev-tool assistant rather than an end-user product feature, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence specifically validating the clai assistant's delegation experience. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of clai's task-delegation quality, and clearer end-user (non-developer) framing of the assistant.
